guides.definition: Creates a PrismaClient and guarantees disconnection after asynchronous work. Generated-project dependency only: configure a Prisma schema, database, and generated client in a project before using these snippets.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Prisma operation performed while the client is active.

examples.title: Count users and disconnect
examples.explanation: A long-lived server usually reuses one client, while a short-lived script should disconnect in a finally block.

guides.definition: Queries a generated Prisma model with a filter, projection, and result limit. Generated-project dependency only: configure a Prisma schema, database, and generated client in a project before using these snippets.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Generated lowercase model property on PrismaClient.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Fields placed inside the where object.

parameters.name: projection
parameters.description: Fields placed inside the select object.

examples.title: Load enabled user summaries
examples.explanation: select reduces transferred columns and makes the result type match exactly what downstream code receives.

guides.definition: Uses an interactive Prisma transaction so related operations commit or roll back together. Generated-project dependency only: configure a Prisma schema, database, and generated client in a project before using these snippets.

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Statements executed with the transaction client.
parameters.defaultValue: const account = await transaction.account.create({ data: accountData });

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Value returned after all operations succeed.

examples.title: Create an account and audit event
examples.explanation: Use the transaction client for every database operation inside the callback so they share one transaction boundary.
